fields.description: Compatibility field for the selected server on the login server selection screen. New consumers should prefer 400.
Current task tracking text on the main world screen.
NPC dialog body text.
NPC dialog option text.
Battle status or battle log text.
System panel title text.
Current recognized foreground screen type. v1 only represents the foreground template, not the full UI stack.
Matched foreground template id.
Foreground template match confidence formatted as a three-decimal string.
Start game button on the login waterfall screen. Value format: label@[left, top, right, bottom].
QR code target on the QR login screen, padded by 50 pixels on every side. Value format: 二维码@[left, top, right, bottom].
Selected server on the login server selection screen. Value format: server_name@[left, top, right, bottom].
Servers with an existing character for the current account. Value format: server_name@[left, top, right, bottom];server_name@[left, top, right, bottom].
Common login character cards on the server selection screen. Value format: character_info@[left, top, right, bottom];character_info@[left, top, right, bottom].
Currently selected character on the character selection screen. Value format: character_info@[left, top, right, bottom].
Selectable character cards. Value format: character_info@[left, top, right, bottom];character_info@[left, top, right, bottom].
Enter game button on the character selection screen. Value format: 进入游戏@[left, top, right, bottom].
Whether the foreground screen blocks normal operation. 1 means blocked; 0 means known not blocked.
Reward popup title or prompt text.
Reward item text from a reward popup.
Executable intents declared by the current foreground template, joined with semicolons in template order.
Diagnostic window-center offset from the 1920x1080 reference position. Published only when either axis exceeds 5 pixels. Value format: window_center_offset@[dx, dy].

reserved_ranges.description: Compatibility fields from expected assets plus login, account, and base text fields. Published meanings must not be changed casually.
Character core state fields, such as hp, mp, level, exp, money, coordinates, and character status.
Battle state and skill slot fields, such as battle_round, selected_target, skill_slot_1_name, and skill_slot_1_cooldown.
Task, NPC, and dialog extension fields.
Modal, system prompt, and blocking state fields.
Reward, inventory, item, and economy fields.
Map, navigation, scene, and coordinate extension fields.
System panel, form, and input field extensions.
Agent action hint and executable intent summary fields.
Debug, compatibility, and experimental fields. Stable consumers should not depend on this range.
